title: Update on Police Efforts to Tackle Bullying and Assault Incidents Outside Temples along Waterloo Mall
what_it_is: Update on Police Efforts to Tackle Bullying and Assault Incidents Outside Temples along Waterloo Mall

sections.label: Agencies maintaining order in area
sections.summary: SPF takes action on bullying or assault and joins operations with SLA, SFA, MCCY and MSF, whose presence has largely maintained order.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: If they come across cases of bullying or assault, they will take action accordingly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The SPF has also participated in joint operations with agencies like the Singapore Land Authority (SLA) and Singapore Food Agency.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth, and the Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF) are also involved when there are incidents involving charitable organisations or vulnerable individuals.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Coordinating Minister for National Security and Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The regular presence of these agencies in the area has helped to largely maintain order in the area.

sections.label: Police response to public disorder
sections.summary: The Police say public disorder cannot be tolerated, enforcement follows crimes, and agencies work closely together on vulnerable individuals.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: On behalf of the Police, public disorder cannot be tolerated or condoned and indeed, if crimes have been committed, then investigation and enforcement has to follow.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: In this case, there are different dimensions of what is happening in the Waterloo Street area and the Member herself is also very familiar.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: And for the cases of conduct where there is no outright crime being committed, but nevertheless may attract some attention, they could be vulnerable individuals involved.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: And in this case, it is important for us to work closely with our sister agencies.
